probability.title: Probability disclosure
probability.disclaimer: Rates are box-level (basis points shown as percent). Actual draws follow server inventory and rules, and may be adjusted for new players, lose streaks, multi-draw packs, and time of day. Changes are logged. After payment, verify draws in order details via seed/hash check. Users under 18 cannot purchase. Spend responsibly. Confirm draw count and amount before paying; after reveal refunds are generally unavailable, pre-reveal review may be requested, and system auto-refunds cover pity stock failure. Questions: submit feedback under Profile — reply within 3 business days.
probability.dynamicNote: Effective rates for your account may differ from the published base rates (newbie / streak / time). Stacked boosts are capped for house edge.
